messages:
Priya S: Quick final check for Thu 3/26 candidate Kiran Patel (SWE II) — panel currently: Samir, Maya, Jordan, Elena. Slot is 10:00–11:00 PT (18:00–19:00 UTC). Please confirm availability or suggest swaps ASAP. Also two quick rubric asks: 1) what should we count under 'system design' vs 'architecture' for this role? 2) how do we log partial answers in scoring? See rubric v3.1 here: https://docs.internal/rubric/v3.1 :memo:

Samir P: Confirmed — available :thumbsup:. I can own the system-design section.

Maya K: I have a calendar conflict 10:00–10:30 PT, can join at 10:30. If someone can cover first 30m that'd be great.

Priya S: Thanks Maya — @Elena R can you cover first half (intro + design kickoff) and hand off to Samir at 10:30?

Elena R: I can cover the first 30m. I'm CET so note I'll be joining earlier for me. Can someone paste the starter prompt + 15m interviewer notes? I prefer a quick checklist.

Jordan L: I'm on for culture & pairing section and can paste a short starter script. Proposed debrief: 11:15 PT in #panel-debrief (30m). Is that okay?

Priya S: Debrief time works for People Ops. We'll ping the channel and post the score sheet link after the interview. One more on scoring: default is 0/1/2 per rubric dimension. If partial answer, pick the lower score and add a comment — that's the current convention. @Samir can expand if you disagree.

Samir P: Agreed on 0/1/2 with comments for partials. Quick note on system-design vs architecture: for this SWE II we treat 'system design' as problem solving + component interactions at app scale (APIs, data flows, tradeoffs) and 'architecture' as long-term choices (data model, infra tradeoffs, latency/cost considerations). In practice, probe for a simple end-to-end design and then ask one deeper infra/scale tradeoff.

Jordan L: Starter script (paste and use as-is):
```
- 00:00–05:00: intro/warmup (role & expectations)
- 05:00–40:00: system design prompt (candidate builds end-to-end, interviewer follows probes)
- 40:00–50:00: pairing/coding micro-problem OR deeper design tradeoff
- 50:00–60:00: wrap-up + candidate Qs
```
Use the 'design probes' checklist in the rubric (section B).

Maya K: If I can only join mid-call, I'll review the recording + take notes before debrief. :ok_hand:

Elena R: Thanks Jordan — that script helps. One tiny rubric tweak question: for 'ownership' do we score based on explicit examples or inferred intent? Sometimes candidates hypothesize rather than show prior ownership.

Samir P: Score ownership on demonstrated behaviors (specific pasts > hypotheticals). If they give only hypotheticals, mark 1 and note you'd like follow-up during debrief.

Priya S: Heads-up: I've created the calendar event and added buffer rooms. @People Ops Bot will send invites in 2m. Please double-check the calendar RSVP so we can reassign if needed.

People Ops Bot: Calendar event created: "Kiran Patel — SWE II Onsite (Panel)" Thu 3/26 10:00–11:00 PT. Link: https://calendar.company/e/abcd1234 :calendar:

Priya S: Thanks everyone. If any swaps needed, reply here before EOD so we can update the panel. We'll link the score sheet in #panel-debrief and tag you when it's live. :raised_hands:
